content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-only-real|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-step-step-deployment-2|Payment Solutions]]-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-works-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a cloud storage solution that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without relying on traditional platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. This is particularly important for creators who want to maintain ownership and control over their digital products, as well as avoid the hefty fees associated with these platforms. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in a significant difference of $921 in fees for 100 sales per month of a $97 product.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Cloudflare R2 is designed to work seamlessly with other tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, allowing for automatic payment verification and instant product delivery. This means that creators can focus on producing high-quality digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates, while the infrastructure handles the logistics of payment and delivery. The use of crypto payments also eliminates the need for traditional payment processors, making it an attractive solution for creators in countries with restricted access to financial services.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Cloudflare R2 is built for digital creators who want to maintain sovereignty over their online stores and products. This includes creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products, and who want to avoid the fees and restrictions associated with traditional platforms. By using Cloudflare R2, creators can build a scalable and secure online store that is fully under their control, allowing them to focus on producing high-quality products and building a loyal customer base.
Cloudflare R2 provides a secure and scalable storage solution for digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Cloudflare R2 solution consists of several components that work together to provide a seamless payment and delivery experience. These include Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and Cloudflare R2 for storage and delivery. By integrating these components, creators can build a robust and scalable online store that can handle a high volume of sales and deliveries, without relying on traditional platforms or payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a Cloudflare R2-based online store today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. From there, they can follow a series of step-by-step instructions to set up their store, configure payment and delivery options, and start selling their digital products to customers around the world.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a combination of Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to build a sovereign online store. This solution allows for automatic payment verification and instant product delivery, without relying on traditional platforms or payment processors. By using crypto payments, creators can also avoid the fees and restrictions associated with traditional payment processors.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, compared to 10% charged by Gumroad.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators who want to learn more about building a sovereign online store, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a valuable resource that includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to get started. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, this kit provides a comprehensive guide to deploying a Cloudflare R2-based online store, including step-by-step instructions and troubleshooting tips.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a Cloudflare R2-based online store, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the included blueprints and templates; set up a Cloudflare R2 storage account and configure it to work with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments; create a digital product, such as an ebook or course, and upload it to Cloudflare R2; configure payment and delivery options using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers; test the store to ensure that payments and deliveries are working correctly; and launch the store and start selling digital products to customers around the world.
